integrity: The claim follows analytically from de Finetti's representation and exact convex/concave envelopes of an integer power on the interval [-1,1]. Endpoint mixing laws are explicit. Numerical verification only replays the root and envelope formulas.
scientific_limitations: The theorem requires infinite exchangeability rather than exchangeability only at a fixed finite length.
Only parity is solved in closed form; higher residue moduli are not claimed.
The originality search is targeted and may miss an equivalent formula under older moment-problem terminology.
title: Sharp parity envelope under infinite Bernoulli exchangeability
